description: On the green tabletop in front of you are several small, brightly colored plastic plates near the back-right corner. The left hand slides a blue plate across the surface and sets it down, then lifts and moves a green plate to place it nearby; next it brings in a yellow plate from the right and sets it down, and finally it pulls the yellow plate forward away from a red plate, unstacking and spreading the plates apart while the hand releases each one.
